problem_statement:
presto select query fails with permission denied for kerberized Hive metastore with hive metastore impersonation enabled.
select query fails when service user and doesn't has read permission to underlaying hdfs directory to hive table. service user can impersonate the actual user who owns the table and directory.
 acutal user is only user who has permissions to the directory.
